title: Badge source boundary ready
summary: M2 may start when the badge route is physically owned, target source rules are enforced for new work and the remaining generated-route baseline cannot grow.
pass_conditions: Badge route resolves to exactly content/ru/components/badge.md
New public routes require one physical Markdown owner
New public UI strings use content/<locale>/lang.json
Public resources/i18n and site.json target inputs are rejected
Existing generated prose routes are a finite zero-growth allowlist
stop_conditions: Badge prose depends on language-pack or projector data
A new generated public route can be introduced
CLI/build messages enter public PageBuilder inputs
nonclaims: Does not pass global source ownership or all-route migration
